defect: the multibit output is safe only if the source changes the bus coherently and slowly enough for the consistency checks
rationale: The destination checks equality across successive synchronized bus samples, but no source-side timing or atomic-update contract is provided. Depending on how data_i changes, the output can be a valid stable word or a mixed word that happened to pass the sampled check.

mutation.description: Retained the consistency-checking multibit synchronizer while leaving source bus update timing unspecified.

provenance.adaptation: Reduced to an eight-bit, one-check consistency synchronizer without source protocol assumptions.

author: gpt-5.6-luna

labels.note: 8 bits are synchronised independently with only a two-sample equality check, and whether data_i is stable/Gray or synchronous is not stated (SDC says synchronous to clk_i, RTL treats it as async).
